title: Senior Director, Design
descriptionText: As Senior Director, Design, you will lead and scale LifeStance's design organization (Product Design, Research, Service Design, Content). You will own the strategy for delivering cohesive, end-to-end experiences across the patient journey and the workflows of all key user groups. Empower and enable designers and researchers to execute this vision. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Marketing, and leadership. Define and drive the design vision and strategy. Evangelize design thinking. Champion the User: drive a culture of deep user empathy and leverage research and data to inform our design direction. Build, mentor, and lead a multidisciplinary design organization (product designers, design ops, design managers, and research). Cross-Functional Collaboration. Oversee strategy for generative and evaluative research - ensure insights continuously inform design direction. Foster experimentation mindset (A/B tests, prototyping, rapid iteration). 10+ years in product / experience / service design, with at least 5 years in leadership. Deep expertise in user-centered design, design systems, service design, research methodologies. Customer insights, product strategy, team building, research strategy.
why: Matches: Research Strategy, Product Strategy, Customer Insights, Team Building, Cross-Functional Collaboration
